tensions.name: Quantum mechanics vs general relativity
tensions.statement: QM is a unitary theory on a fixed background with superposition; GR is a deterministic theory of a dynamical metric. They use incompatible mathematics (operators on Hilbert space vs pseudo-Riemannian geometry) and disagree about background independence and the role of the observer. No accepted theory quantizes the metric or makes superpositions of geometries sense.
tensions.what_a_unifier_must_do: Produce a single object whose two faces are (a) quantum/record structure and (b) a dynamical metric sourced by matter, with an observable-preserving bridge between superposition and geometry.
tensions.minimum_unification_requirement: ONE substrate object yielding BOTH a quantum record sector AND a metric sector, with a DERIVED cross-constraint (e.g. matter content constrains local geometry), expressed via observable-preserving bridge maps -- not two parallel read-outs glued by a shared label. For SBT specifically: Fix(E) (matter-like records) must demonstrably CONSTRAIN d_eta curvature on the SAME Phat (U001 stronger lemma), or the tension is untouched.
tensions.sbt_status: BARELY TOUCHED. U001 proposes co-reading Fix(E) and d_eta off one Phat, but the GR leg is analogical (audit-defined pseudo-metric, not a tensor) and the cross-constraint lemma does not exist. Deflation: two costumes (idempotent fixed points + -log of an operator) on one mannequin unless the matter->curvature lemma is proved.

what_it_unifies: (aspirationally) the full Standard Model + quantum gravity
baselines.how_it_unifies: Replace point particles with 1D strings (and higher branes) in 10/11 dimensions; particle species and forces are vibrational modes; gravity arises automatically (the graviton is a closed-string mode); consistency requires supersymmetry and extra compactified dimensions.
baselines.scope: Most ambitious: a candidate theory of everything including quantum gravity.
baselines.empirical_status: No distinctive confirmed prediction at accessible energies; the landscape of ~10^500 vacua undermines uniqueness/predictivity. Mathematically rich, empirically unconfirmed.
limitations: enormous vacuum landscape => weak predictivity
requires unobserved supersymmetry + extra dimensions
no measured distinctive prediction
background-dependence in most formulations
the measure over vacua is unsolved
baselines.vs_sbt: String theory genuinely contains gravity + gauge + matter in one object (its real strength) but suffers a landscape/measure problem. SBT shares the measure problem in spirit (MISS_MEASURE) but at a vastly lower altitude: it has no graviton, no extra dimensions, no continuum, no dynamics-from-first-principles. SBT is a finite meta-calculus, not a TOE candidate.

what_it_unifies: general relativity (quantizing the gravitational field itself)
baselines.how_it_unifies: Canonically quantize GR in a background-independent way using spin networks / spin foams; geometry (area, volume) becomes discrete with quantized spectra; spacetime is built from quantized loops of the gravitational field.
baselines.scope: Quantum gravity specifically; does not aim to unify the other forces.
baselines.empirical_status: No confirmed prediction; recovering smooth classical spacetime + the correct low-energy limit (and matter coupling) remains contentious. Background-independence is its principled selling point.
limitations: the semiclassical / continuum limit is not firmly established
matter coupling and the full dynamics are incomplete
no distinctive confirmed prediction
does not unify the other interactions
baselines.vs_sbt: LQG shares SBT's DISCRETE, finite-combinatorial instinct (discrete geometry, no preferred continuum) and the hard 'recover the continuum' problem. But LQG genuinely quantizes the metric with a background-independent dynamics; SBT has no metric tensor, no diffeomorphism invariance, and explicitly disclaims deriving spacetime (MISS_SPACETIME). Closest in SPIRIT, far apart in content.

what_it_unifies: a gravitational (bulk) theory in d+1 dimensions
a non-gravitational gauge/CFT (boundary) theory in d dimensions
baselines.how_it_unifies: A holographic duality: quantum gravity in an asymptotically Anti-de-Sitter bulk is EXACTLY equivalent to a conformal field theory on its boundary; bulk geometry/dynamics is encoded in boundary entanglement (Ryu-Takayanagi), realizing 'spacetime from entanglement'.
baselines.scope: Quantum gravity <-> gauge theory in specific (AdS) backgrounds; the sharpest controlled instance of holography.
baselines.empirical_status: A precise, much-tested DUALITY (theoretical evidence overwhelming) but for AdS, not our de-Sitter-like universe; no direct experimental test. The deepest concrete realization of the holographic principle.
limitations: requires AdS (negative curvature), not our universe
the bulk dictionary in realistic backgrounds is incomplete
no direct empirical test
background-dependent (asymptotic AdS)
baselines.vs_sbt: AdS/CFT is the GOLD STANDARD for 'matter/geometry from a common object via an observable-preserving bridge' (RT formula = entanglement <-> area) -- exactly what SBT's T_MATTER_SPACETIME tension demands. SBT's F33 'holographic compression' (R-IV) is a declared normal form with NO bulk-boundary dictionary, no RT formula, no derived geometry. AdS/CFT shows what a REAL bridge map looks like; SBT has only the label.

baselines.how_it_unifies: Treat the Einstein equations as an equation of state: derive them from thermodynamic relations (dQ=TdS) applied to local Rindler horizons (Jacobson), or treat gravity as an entropic force from changes in information/entropy associated with holographic screens (Verlinde). Gravity is emergent, not fundamental.
baselines.scope: Gravity as an emergent/thermodynamic phenomenon; aims to explain WHY the field equations hold.
baselines.empirical_status: Reproduces Einstein's equations as a thermodynamic identity (a genuine result for Jacobson); Verlinde's entropic-force and emergent-dark-gravity versions are contested and have tension with data (e.g. lensing).
limitations: the microscopic degrees of freedom are unspecified
entropic-force versions struggle with concrete predictions / data
presupposes horizon thermodynamics (S=A/4) rather than deriving it
quantum consistency unclear
baselines.vs_sbt: Closest in PHILOSOPHY to SBT's 'distance is accounting' (IF_METRIC) and 'gravity/geometry as bookkeeping' instinct. But entropic gravity uses PHYSICAL entropy and horizon thermodynamics to recover the actual Einstein equations; SBT's Sigma_T/EPR are explicitly NOT physical entropy (MISS_THERMO) and it recovers no field equation. SBT is the toy-altitude, information-proxy cousin -- same slogan, no physical S, no G_mu_nu.

what_it_unifies: disparate microphysics into universal low-energy descriptions
baselines.how_it_unifies: Organize theories by energy scale: integrate out high-energy modes to obtain a low-energy effective Lagrangian; the RG semigroup flows couplings between scales; universality means microscopically different systems share IR fixed points and critical exponents. Unification is across SCALES, not forces.
baselines.scope: Cross-scale structure of essentially ALL of physics (condensed matter, particle physics, statistical mechanics).
baselines.empirical_status: Spectacularly successful and confirmed: critical exponents, running couplings, the Standard Model as an EFT. The most pervasively validated 'unification' principle in physics.
limitations: does not fix the UV completion / fundamental theory
non-perturbative regimes are hard
Mori-Zwanzig memory makes exact closure generically impossible
universality classes are descriptive, not derived from a deeper principle
baselines.vs_sbt: This is SBT's NATURAL comparison class and where the deflation bites: SBT's coarse-graining lens + Fix(E) + CD_tau ARE finite-state EFT/closure constructs. SBT's genuine contribution is the EXACT closure-deficit obstruction CD_tau (Mori-Zwanzig analogue, R029). BUT NG_LADDER_IDEM FORBIDS an RG SEMIGROUP (a fixed completion stabilizes in one step), so SBT has coarse-graining WITHOUT RG flow -- a strictly weaker structure than EFT.

what_it_unifies: the emergence of classicality (preferred basis, apparent collapse)
baselines.how_it_unifies: Environmental entanglement suppresses interference between pointer states; einselection dynamically singles out a robust preferred (pointer) basis (those states least disturbed by the environment); quantum-Darwinism explains objective classical records via redundant environmental imprints. Classicality EMERGES from unitary system+environment dynamics.
baselines.scope: The quantum-to-classical transition / measurement problem (the basis and apparent-collapse parts).
baselines.empirical_status: Decoherence timescales are measured and confirmed; einselection and quantum Darwinism are well-supported. WIDELY accepted as explaining apparent collapse and the preferred basis -- but acknowledged NOT to solve single-outcome selection or derive the Born rule by itself.
limitations: does not by itself select a single outcome (the 'and-or' / definite-outcome problem remains)
does not derive the Born rule without additional assumptions
the system-environment split is somewhat conventional
baselines.vs_sbt: The DIRECT comparison for SBT's flagship R001. Decoherence DERIVES the pointer basis dynamically (einselection); SBT TAKES the record basis as a FREE input (MISS_LENS_SEL) and only recovers idempotent dephasing GIVEN that basis. Both stop short of single-outcome and Born rule. So SBT is strictly WEAKER than decoherence on the very domain it most credibly engages: it reskins Lueders pinching but cannot derive einselection.
